## Problem and change

Describe the problem, how to reproduce it, and what this change makes Caspian do. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results, including executed test counts. For a bug fix, show the failing case before the change and its result after.

State which OS and connection arrangements you tested. Distinguish tests with simulated devices from tests on real hardware. Name anything not tested and why. For documentation-only changes, report link, rendering, translation, and privacy checks as applicable.

## Documentation and privacy

- [ ] Updated affected guides and translations, or explained why no documentation change is needed.
- [ ] Kept diagrams and instructions visible without collapsible sections, and preserved RTL formatting where needed.
- [ ] Reviewed the diff and attachments for credentials, personal configuration, network identifiers, and local artifacts.

Do not attach real proxy links, subscriptions, configuration files, passwords, keys, QR codes, public IP addresses, home Wi-Fi names, MAC/BSSID addresses, serial numbers, or personal hostnames. Use synthetic test data. Include screenshots only after checking and removing private values.
